title: South Florida nightlife guide, cheapest first
igCaption:
Cheap plans first for the next few nights.
Nov 11 to 21, South Florida, free and ticketed.

Sources: Eventbrite, Resident Advisor, Secret Miami, Miami New Times

#SouthFlorida #FortLauderdale #Wynwood #Nightlife

scenes.text: Need a plan for the next few nights? Start with the free ones, then work up from there.
First up is Fort Lauderdale. Eventbrite has a Free Ladies Night listing for November twenty-first. The page puts it in Fort Lauderdale, so that one comes in free and easy to start the week.
scenes.caption: First up is Fort Lauderdale. Eventbrite has a Free Ladies Night listing for Nov. 21. The page puts it in Fort Lauderdale, so that one comes in free and easy to start the week.

scenes.text: Next is Ctrl Room at Club M two. Resident Advisor has it listed with tickets on November eleventh. Club M two is in Miami, and the listing keeps it on the radar for a late-night stop.
scenes.caption: Next is Ctrl Room at Club M2. Resident Advisor has it listed with tickets on Nov. 11. Club M2 is in Miami, and the listing keeps it on the radar for a late-night stop.

scenes.text: Club Perreo is on the Resident Advisor calendar at Supernatural Haus. The listing went up November fourth. It is a Latin party at a Miami room built for dancing. If you’re at Perreo, open NEAR later and see who danced there.
scenes.caption: Club Perreo is on the Resident Advisor calendar at Supernatural Haus. The listing went up Nov. 4. It is a Latin party at a Miami room built for dancing. If you’re at Perreo, open NEAR later and see who danced there.

scenes.text: Then comes Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival at Mana Wynwood on Saturday, November twenty-first. Rockstar Games and PlayStation announced it, III Points is producing it, and the event uses two stages. Tickets run through a lottery.
scenes.caption: Then comes Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival at Mana Wynwood on Saturday, Nov. 21. Rockstar Games and PlayStation announced it, III Points is producing it, and the event uses two stages. Tickets run through a lottery.

scenes.text: That gives you one free night, two club options, and one lottery ticket for the calendar. A night out in South Florida can leave you with a face you noticed and never named, and that is the kind of gap NEAR fills.
